summary: Depth on NSE cash: the MarketFeedV3 frame alone reaches no Depth subscriber; each MarketDepthService frame then gives the book with the latest quote, a full five-level book replaces it, and an empty book clears it.

notes: FEED and DEPTH are the web test's frames; DEPTH5 is DEPTH with five levels a side and new totals, DEPTH_EMPTY with no levels and zero totals (worked here).

deviations.reason: data.mode is the label every broker's frames carry on the desktop (ltp, quote, full), as the recorded Zerodha transcripts carry it; this web adapter puts its subscription mode number there.

The web passes 5paisa's JSON number on as it came, so a whole price (the web test's OpenRate 445) goes out as an integer (445); the desktop sends every price as a float (445.0), as the docs' frames (docs/prompt/websockets-format.md) and every other broker's prices are. Same value, other JSON type.

The web sends 5paisa's ChgPcnt as percent_change for every instrument; the desktop's common carrier sends the change fields for indices only, so an equity or a future loses it. Carrier gap (change fields for every exchange, audit C04, lane wire).

The desktop pads each side of 5paisa's book to five levels with zero levels (FivepaisaFeed depth_book, v.resize(5, ..)), so a book of one bid and one ask, or an empty book, goes out as five levels a side; the web sends the levels 5paisa sent (_extract_depth_data), and rules.md says no padded book. Desktop defect.
